query:
UPDATE services
           SET is_active = TRUE,
               last_reactivated_at = NOW(),
               active_days = $4,
               auto_deactivate_at = $3
         WHERE id = $1
           AND user_id = $2
         RETURNING id,
                   auto_deactivate_at AS "auto_deactivate_at: Option<chrono::DateTime<Utc>>"
